title: Extend one-qubit logical safety to every fixed-support operator at polynomial thermal cost
statement: For a syndrome-diagonal stable projector with[O_j,sigma_v]Pstable=0 and fixed support size kstar, define Psafe=product_{phasefree Pauli e,weight<=kstar} e^dagger Pstable e. The factors commute in syndrome space. Every suffix in the commutator expansion of a Pauli string maps Psafe into Pstable, so[O_j,A_X]Psafe=0 for all operators on <=kstar qubits. If each qubit meets<=d0 stabilizers, conjugating the Gibbs state by a weight-m Pauli costs at most exp(2beta d0m), and Tr[(I-Psafe)rho_beta]<=q_beta sum_{m<=kstar}binomial(n,m)3^m exp(2beta d0m). For fixed kstar this is polynomial times q_beta; it is an equilibrium bound, not perturbed dynamical confinement.
